cmd: sitelooper do "On the dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/afyhk91qg10cga/fwgr52-n1-bench-dashboard, set the dashboard's default time range to the last 6 hours AND set the auto-refresh interval to 1 minute: open the time picker in the top bar, choose 'Last 6 hours' from the range presets, and set the refresh interval dropdown to '1m' (1 minute). Verify afterwards that the dashboard settings JSON (Dashboard settings > General) or a reload shows the saved time range is Last 6 hours and refresh 1m; report what you observe." --session fwgr52-n1 --timeout 600 --max-turns 60
out:
[OK] Set the dashboard default time range to Last 6 hours via the top-bar time picker and the auto-refresh interval to 1m via the refresh dropdown, then entered edit mode, opened Save dashboard, ticked "Update default time range" (plus "Update default refresh value" so the 1m interval would persist too) and clicked Save — the "Dashboard saved" alert appeared. Verified by loading the bare dashboard URL with no query parameters: Grafana redirected to ?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m and the page showed time range "Last 6 hours" and refresh "1m", proving those are the saved defaults; both panels "fwgr52-n1 Notes" and "fwgr52-n1 Availability" are present.
  learned: stored s_679b2b
Steps: (1) Opened the top-bar time picker ("Time range selected: Last 6 hours") and chose the "Last 6 hours" quick range; the picker closed and the range applied (URL from=now-6h&to=now). (2) Opened the auto-refresh dropdown ("Auto refresh turned off. Choose refresh time interval") and selected the "1m" option (role=menuitemradio, aria-label "1 minute"); the top bar then showed "1m". (3) The toolbar Save button only exists in edit mode, so I clicked Edit, then "Save dashboard". The save drawer initially showed "No changes to save" with Save disabled; ticking "Update default time range" and "Update default refresh value" enabled Save. I ticked the required "Update default time range" checkbox and, because the verification also requires refresh 1m to be persisted, also ticked "Update default refresh value" (the instruction only mandated the time-range one and did not forbid the refresh one). Clicking Save produced the "Dashboard saved" alert. (4) Exited edit mode (returned cleanly, no discard prompt). Verification: I then navigated to the bare URL with NO query parameters; Grafana redirected to ...?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m, and the page rendered the time-range button as "Last 6 hours" and the refresh button as "1m", which only happens if those are the dashboard's saved defaults. Both panels also still render: "fwgr52-n1 Notes" and "fwgr52-n1 Availability" (stat value 91.9). Note: I did not open Dashboard settings > JSON model, since the bare-URL reload already proves the saved defaults are applied.
